{{Quote|Sir! We captured him! He's the one that set the det packs.|A Grey Squadron member, bringing the Imperial saboteur to X2|<ref name="Elite Squadron NDS" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] was a '''member''' of the self-proclaimed [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[X1]]'s [[X1's faction|faction]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which opposed the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At one point, he was stationed at the [[Dathomir Imperial Prison|Imperial prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], which X1's forces controlled. When X1 relocated his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], the Human was among the few remaining [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] left behind at the [[Prison/Legends|prison]], as it simultaneously came [[Mission to Dathomir (Galactic Civil War)|under attack]] from both the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] clan of the [[Witches of Dathomir]] and the New Republic's [[Grey Squadron]], led by X1's [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] "brother," [[X2]]. During the battle, the Human successfully infiltrated Grey [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron's]] landing site, planting [[Detonation pack|detpacks]] on their [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] and inflicting heavy [[Death/Legends|casualties]] to the unit. X2 captured the Human and interrogated him regarding X1's plans, but the [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]] refused to reveal anything, leading X2 to [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-choke]] him in anger.

==Biography==
{{Quote|My brother is on Mustafar. What is he planning?''"<br />"''Hmph, don't bother! I'm trained to resist your pathetic Jedi mind tricks.''"<br />"''Resist THIS!''"<br />"''AGHHH&hellip;!|X2 questions the Imperial saboteur before Force-choking him|<ref name="Elite Squadron NDS" />}}
[[File:X2_Force_choke.jpg|thumb|left|200px|X2 Force-chokes the Imperial saboteur.]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] was a member of a splinter [[X1's faction|faction]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that was led by a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] named [[X1]], a self-proclaimed [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. As part of his training, the Human was taught how to resist [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricks]]. Serving X1 in the latter's fight against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the Human was at one point stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] as part of a contingent guarding the [[Dathomir Imperial Prison|Imperial prison]], which X1 used to conduct cloning experiments. Eventually, X1 abandoned the facility and relocated his main forces to the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], leaving behind a small regiment, including the Human, to operate the Dathomir [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. After X1 left, however, a group of [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]&mdash;a sect of the native [[Witches of Dathomir]]&mdash;[[Mission to Dathomir (Galactic Civil War)|attacked]] the facility. Almost simultaneously, the New Republic [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Grey Squadron]] arrived on the planet in an attempt to locate X1. Grey Squadron was led by the clone named [[X2]], who was X1's [[Gene/Legends|genetic]] "brother" and also a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. X2 took with him a small portion of his squadron and left to investigate the prison, leaving the rest of his men at their landing site to guard their [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]].<ref name="Elite Squadron NDS" />

Seeing an opportunity to [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] the enemy's efforts, the Human slipped to the landing site undetected and planted [[Detonation pack|detpacks]] on the majority of Grey Squadron's [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]]. The resulting explosions inflicted heavy [[Death/Legends|casualties]] for the New Republic forces and took many X-wings out of commission. During the commotion, however, the Imperial saboteur was captured by the surviving [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. X2 soon arrived back at the site after finishing his mission at the prison and discovering that X1 had moved to Mustafar. The saboteur was brought before X2, who questioned him regarding what X1's plans were on Mustafar. The saboteur refused to speak, claiming that his training would protect him against any [[The Force/Legends|Force]] influence X2 could attempt. Angered, the Jedi then used the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends|choke]] the saboteur but was soon stopped and calmed down by one of the Grey Squadron members, [[Shara]]. The remainder of Grey Squadron then left the planet in pursuit of X1.<ref name="Elite Squadron NDS" />

==Personality and traits==
The Human saboteur was loyal to his master, X1, refusing to reveal the latter's plans to X2. He was dismissive toward Jedi and their Force-influencing powers, claiming that his training would protect him against any mind tricks. The Human had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin.<ref name="Elite Squadron NDS" />

==Equipment==
The saboteur wore the gray [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|uniform]]<ref name="Elite Squadron NDS" /> of an [[Vehicle Command Crewer|Imperial Army pilot]],<ref name="ISB">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> complete with a [[Armor/Legends|helmet]], during his service on Dathomir.<ref name="Elite Squadron NDS" />

==Behind the scenes==
This character appeared exclusively in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version of the [[2009]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'' at the end of the first mission of Act III.<ref name="Elite Squadron NDS" />
